intro: Yemen has high green mountains, desert valleys and the remarkable island of Socotra.

chapters.title: Mountains and valleys
text: The western highlands rise above 3,000 m; Jabal an-Nabi Shu'ayb is the highest peak in Arabia. Farmers have built terraces up steep slopes for thousands of years. To the east, Hadhramaut is a long valley with mud-brick towns.
A coastal plain called the Tihama runs along the Red Sea.

chapters.title: Socotra
text: Socotra's dragon's blood trees and many other plants and animals are found nowhere else on Earth.

keyTerms.meaning: A flat step cut into a hillside for farming.
